development: Four labeled Scroll 1 cubes for training; remaining Scroll 1 cube for selecting settings. No Scroll 5 performance inspection.
test: All 6 official Scroll 5 cubes; one deterministically chosen eligible segment per manual tree; no cap. Endpoints are provided. Each segment has at least 3 interior manual nodes, original click span 64..128 voxels.
primary_measure: Paired, per-fiber mean 3D distance of original hidden interior nodes to the continuous predicted polyline in voxels.
secondary: Reverse distance to the manual polyline. Fraction of fibers whose 90th-percentile hidden-node error exceeds 5 voxels. Report all cube results.
review_threshold: A change between first and second fits above 0.67 voxels means higher review priority; set from the development cube before testing.
